Name: Upgrade Line Sprinklers
Author: BaconCatBug
Description:
Adds recipies to upgrade line sprinklers from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers Redux (1.6 Compatible)[/url].

Uses the same materials and unlock requirements as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16689]Upgrade Sprinklers[/url] but takes in and outputs the Line Sprinklers.

Requires:
SMAPI (duh).
Content Patcher (also duh).
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers Redux (1.6 Compatible)[/url]

Upgrade Sprinklers is not required.
